$comment: JSON Schema (draft 2020-12 keywords only: type, properties, required, additionalProperties, items, enum, pattern, minLength, maxLength, minItems, maxItems, $ref, $defs). x-code and x-missing are ours: the problem code build/check_intake.py reports when that part has the wrong type, pattern or value (x-code) or is missing or empty (x-missing). Every length limit is what the owner console shows without cutting, so what the owner accepts is what gets written.
title: Meeting intake
description: The organizer's output for one client meeting (templates/meeting-intake.md). Five buckets; every item has a stable iid, an audience, a source and, where it can be asked, a quote.

consent.description: Who gave consent to record, and when. A blank line is refused. If it was not given or not recorded, say so in words: that passes the check, and must then be raised to the owner as a question.

iid.description: Any item's iid: a bucket letter (g w s n q) and a number. Unique across every intake file of the client; never reused.

audience.description: Who signs it: client (meaning, stories, numbers) or builder (the harness's shape). Each has a console of their own.

source.description: Where it was said: 'YYYY-MM-DD hh:mm:ss' (meeting date and the timestamp of the quote) or 'doc:<name>[#<place>]' (a document). Several are joined by '; '.

quote.description: The client's exact words, in their language. Never translated, never shortened into our words.

unsure.description: The organizer is not sure it heard or understood this.

note.description: The organizer's one-line note: what it is unsure about, or what it inferred.

goal.description: Not asked on its own: it is the why of the stories it explains.

word.description: The client's own name for a thing. Becomes a glossary row once the owner says yes.

story.description: Only for a need the client stated. Becomes a user-stories row once the owner says yes.

number.description: A number the client stated. Waits as a pending value in the client's data folder; drives nothing until a human confirms it.

key.description: One key per idea: two numbers with the same key and different values are a contradiction and must be a question.

value.description: The number as digits ('45', '0.5'), or the range the client gave ('20-30' or '20–30'). The client's own words stay in the quote.

question.description: What was unclear, contradictory or left for later. A contradiction lists every item it is about.

about.description: The iids this question is about; both sides of a contradiction.

options.description: The answers, when they can be listed: the owner picks one.

suggest.description: The organizer's best answer and why; one of options when there are options.
